prayerExcerpt.en-US: We may with joy spread abroad the fullness of Christian charity.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Possamos difundir com alegria a riqueza do amor cristão.

meta.face: A stout, heavy-set man of about eighty, clean-shaven, with a large round face, full cheeks and a double chin, a broad, prominent nose, small twinkling dark-brown eyes creased with laughter lines, and a broad, kindly smile.
meta.basis: His official photographs as pope (1958–63): a round, smiling, heavy-set old man with a large nose, in red mozzetta and embroidered stole; the camauro distinguishes him from the other popes.
